meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 把每个 git worktree、分支或 PR 当作一个角色,拉进同一个共享 markdown 聊天室分轮对话,最后汇总出一份「以哪个 worktree 为目标、按什么顺序合并」的计划。全程只读,不提交也不合并。
howto.when: 当你要求比较多个 worktree、分支或 PR 的改动并汇总成一份合并计划时触发;候选只有零个或一个时会说明这不算 standup,并建议放宽范围。

say.text: 帮我看看哪些分支最近 24 小时有改动,做个 standup
say.note: 先列出候选名单让你确认

say.text: 把 PR #123 和这几个 worktree 一起拉进 standup
say.note: 手动挑选可与时间窗口混用

say.text: standup 结论出来后,把计划交给 /do 执行合并

howto.what_en: Each git worktree, branch, or PR joins a shared markdown chatroom as its own agent; rounds run until they agree on one consolidation plan—the target worktree and merge order. It is read-only: nobody commits or merges in the room.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to compare changes across worktrees, branches, or PRs and produce one consolidation plan. With zero or one candidate it says this isn't a standup and offers to widen the search.

say_en.text: Scan which branches changed in the last 24 hours and run a standup
say_en.note: Lists candidates for you to confirm

say_en.text: Pull PR #123 in with these worktrees for the standup
say_en.note: Mixes hand-picked branches and PRs with a time window

say_en.text: Hand the standup plan to /do to run the merges
